description: Recommended fits of Test K run 3, chosen after reading results/k3_fits.json and report/report_numbers.json: lowest sigma_d among the XGPaint-paintable laws of range R3 that extrapolate sensibly (pressure: brk_amp, since free puts x_c beyond the data at low mass; gas: free, the lowest sigma_d, with its large-alpha caveat stated in the report and the smooth alternatives brk_all (not an XGPaint type) and orig). Read by k_compare.py (snippet), make_figures.py and report/write_narrative.py; all numbers quoted come from the results files.
